name: Katari
tagline: Sleek, sharp, and quiet on their feet
description: Feline humanoids with retractable claws, slit pupils, and heightened senses, Katari names are sleek and quick on the tongue.

features.name: Feline Instincts
features.description: When you make an Agility Roll, you can spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.

features.name: Retracting Claws
features.description: Make an Agility Roll to scratch a target within Melee range. On a success, they become temporarily Vulnerable.
